description: This file contains the PHP class 'ReturnAction' which manages CRUD operations for 'return_action' entities, including handling descriptions in multiple languages, within the OpenCart administration model's localisation namespace. It interacts with the database for inserting, editing, deleting, and retrieving return action data, and manages cache invalidation.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: A model class for managing return actions, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return action data, as well as managing associated multilingual descriptions within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Inserts a new return action record with associated descriptions into the database, and returns the new record ID.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Updates an existing return action record and its descriptions based on the given return_action_id.

methods.name: deleteReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return action descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return action record for a given ID, considering the current language setting.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple return actions, optionally ordered and paginated, with lazy caching.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Retrieves all return action descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for a return action across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for all return actions in a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total count of return action records for the current language.
